title: ‘BTS Lyrics Inside Volume 2’: The K-Pop Supergroup Breaks Down More of Its Songs In a New Book
summary: Calling all ARMY! The Bangtan Boys' new book is available for preorder online right now.
contentText:

In mid-September, Running Press released volume 1 of a lyrics book in partnership with the K-pop supergroup BTS. And now, volume 2 is available for preorder with release in spring 2027.

$24.23 $26.00 7% off

preorder Now On Amazon

On sale for $24.23 (was $26) on Amazon, BTS Lyrics Inside Volume 2 is a new book that explores 10 more songs from the superstars’ albums Proof and the Most Beautiful Moment in Life series. Members RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook break down the deeper meaning and messages of songs including “I NEED U,” “RUN,” “EPILOGUE: Young Forever” and others.

The lyrics book is ready for preorder right now, with release set for Tuesday (March 2, 2027). Additionally, the publishing company has the second volume of a BTS cookbook titled BTS Recipe Book Volume 2 , which is also available with release on the same date.

And if you’re an Amazon Prime member, you can purchase now and BTS Lyrics Inside Volume 2 will be delivered to your home in less than two days, thanks to Prime Delivery, when it’s released.

BTS Lyrics Inside Volume 2 is also available for preorder as a Kindle ebook . It’s less expensive than the physical hardcover book, as it’s on sale for $13.99 (was $26). The ebook version comes out on Tuesday (March 2). If you buy now, it will be delivered digitally to your Kindle or Kindle mobile app upon release.

The lyrics book BTS Lyrics Inside Volume 2  by BTS is ready for preorder and on sale for $24.23 (was $26) on Amazon. It’s available starting on Tuesday, (March 2).

Meanwhile, the music book is available at BookShop.org for $24.23 (was $26), while it can be preordered at Barnes & Noble priced at $26.
